title: Neoloxal's Cosmetics Resource Pack
description: The resource pack to my Neoloxal's Cosmetics Datapack!
body:
The datapack to Neoloxal's Cosmetics! (For somereason the resource pack doesnt download with the datapack)

As my first resource pack and datapack on modrinth this adds craftable cosmetics. I belive that these are really easy to use and ones that you'll probably use instead of have tons of cosmetics you will never use. I also make sure to put effort into each cosmetic. (I hope) I also hope that these spice up your gameplay adding a little bit of character to your usuall building. I would recommend this on servers specificaly for events or what ever you want.

Current Cosmetics:
- Top hat (1.0.0)
- Sunglasses (1.0.0)
- Crazy Glasses (1.0.0)
- Supporter Plushy (1.0.0)
- Arrow Headband (1.0.0)
